notes.title: PATCH 1.9.3 Ability Update
notes.content:
[b]update 1.9.3 - Sentinel Cursed Knight[/b]
The Ability Update



Welcome to update 1.9.3 in this update, we have overhauled the UI and ability system.

You can now switch 5 of the ability into any ability that the game offers. If you have enough antributes you can use them. This makes everything much more playable and user friendly.

[b]Tweaks[/b]

- Magic Missile ending particle changed
- Magic Missile Sound added

[b]Visual additions[/b]

- Main menu lightning changed
- Main menu Skybox changed
- Added a ''Need more antributes!'' Popup when you dont have enough strength, intelligece, resolve or corruption.

[b]Gameplay[/b]

- Overhauled HUD
   - Added camera toggle button, allows between 2 different cameras, long distance and short distance.
   - Added a speed reset button, allows the player to reset the character's speed in case of bug.
   - Added ability selection screen.
   - Removed 9 ability buttons (6, 7, 8, 9, f1, f2, f3, f4)

[b]Fixes
[/b]
- Dragonchaser helm antributes - & +.

Thanks everyone for purchasing Sentinel, and I hope you guys enjoy the game. Let me know if there's any issues, if so, join the discord and come and say hi! Let's improve the game together.

https://discord.gg/G8RwCnt

Cheers!

Darryl
Sentinel Studios

notes.title: PATCH 1.9
notes.content:
Welcome to update 1.9, in this update, we have overhauled the animations and leveling rewards.

Tweaks

- Damage from Gryphon reduced to 142 instead of 150.

Gameplay

- Changed running animation
- Added sprinting ''Press & hold shift to sprint''
- Added walking ''Press & hold Cntrl to walk''
- Added tilting of animation when moving with mouse'
- Added level rewards after each 5 levels. 100 hp & 100 mana


We have added a roadmap to the discord & Instagram, please check it out! 2.0 & 2.1 is going to have alot of new additions tot the game!

https://discord.gg/G8RwCnt

Cheers!

Darryl
Sentinel Studios

notes.title: PATCH 1.8
notes.content:
Welcome to update 1.8, in this update, we have overhauled some of the damages done and visual areas.

Tweaks

- Poisen debuff damage lowered to 10 per 10 seconds instead of 25 per 10 seconds.
- Injured debuff damage lowered to 25 instead of 50.

Visual additions

- Added more in depth terrain in some areas, more plants/rocks.
- Changed grass texture to a 4k grass texture.
- Added better lightning indoors
- Added larger tower to chapel

Gameplay

- Added more enemies in the beginning area (Valley of Souls).
- Added extra tutorial step, explaining basic combat.
- Added more difficult enemies in most areas.

Fixes

- Fixed resolution buttons in menu, now you can actually change the resolution.

Thanks everyone for purchasing Sentinel, and I hope you guys enjoy the game. Let me know if there's any issues, if so, join the discord and come and say hi! Let's improve the game together.

https://discord.gg/G8RwCnt

Cheers!

Darryl
Sentinel Studios

notes.title: Patch 1.7
notes.content:
Hi all! We will introduce some fixes and tweaks to gameplay in this patch.

[b]Tweaks[/b]

- Griffon health to 1200 instead of 1350
- Griffon damage to 150 instead of 182
- Prices lowered of demus coin shop
    - Hammer of thorn, axe of gorn : 50 demus instead of 80
    - Hammer of a thousand sins : 100 demus instead of 150


[b]Fixes[/b]

- Shop selling right items, some shops sold wrong items when clicked, that's fixed now.
- Issue where sometimes you would teleport out of the map after saving
- Issue where the enemy crawler would teleport through walls

Thanks everyone for playing, and we hope you guys have fun!

Join the discord for more info/community.
https://discord.gg/G8RwCnt

- Sentinel Studios -

notes.title: PATCH 1.3 ''Crooked Woods''
notes.content:
[b]Changelog[/b]

After a succesfull test run, we've encountered some issues. These were now hopefully all resolved!

Fixes:

- Fixed Door Kasweihn castle closing after reload
- Fixed Caverns invis wall blocking the way
- Fixed dialog in the Sanctum from disabling your mouse

Tweaks:

- Menu music made less loud
- Plague area before forgemaster boss ambient sound made less loud
- Spell 1 (Magic Missile) costs 10 mana instead of 30
- Spell 5 (Magic Blast) costs 35 mana instead of 50
- Spell F3 (Arcance shock) costs 30 mana instead of 65
- Range of Spell 7 & 8 drastically lowered
- Enemies detection range made higher
- Loot from normal enemies changed from 1-20 shards to 5-35 shards
- ''Injured'' Debuff damage after 5 seconds changed to 50 instead of 100.

Added:

- Added animation/particle effect to ''On Fire'' Debuff.
- Added animation/particle effect to ''Injured'' Debuff.
- NEW AREA: Crooked Woods, near Kasweihn Castle, with new items and 1 new enemy encounter.
